owner_toolbox_instruction.scope: Implement real distinct capabilities; keep optional candidates default-off; machine-readable identity cards; route selection does not invoke tools or grant authority; focused tests and no Full Foundation during development.

owner_c1_update.scope: Retention, replacement, coexistence, or retirement depends on same-task comparison evidence; insufficient evidence remains COMPARISON_UNKNOWN.

gap_audit.existing_single_run_executor: function_os.run_bounded_symbolic_spec executes one FunctionSpec/input pair and performs N1-N7 internal checks; it does not bind a baseline plus multiple independent assumption edits or summarize conclusion fragility.
gap_audit.existing_operation_selector: ignition.select_bounded_thinking_operation may propose VERIFY but does not execute a model probe or construct a paired baseline/probe record.
gap_audit.existing_evidence_update_comparator: research.compare_evidence_update_snapshots compares caller-supplied evidence snapshots and is not a model intervention executor.
gap_audit.gap: A bounded wrapper that evaluates one declared model against a baseline and independent assumption-bound edits, preserves every result, and marks the report as model-conditional is not represented by these adjacent tools.
gap_audit.claim_ceiling: This gap is an interface comparison within the checked candidate inventory; it does not assert that no other project or human process can manually perform a counterfactual analysis.

does: Reuse the existing bounded pure Function OS evaluator for one baseline and at most eight one-input edits.
Require each edit to bind to one caller-declared assumption and its named model input.
Compare exact model outputs and keep direction mismatches, precondition failures, and evaluation errors visible.
Mark admissibility as caller-declared and unverified; label all outputs model-conditional.
does_not: Observe or change the actual world.
Admit causal identification, validate the caller's assumptions, or determine real-world intervention admissibility.
Rewrite source evidence, execute external tools, invoke providers, or grant permissions.

claim_ceiling: A new optional local interface for assumption-bound sensitivity probes over a bounded caller-declared symbolic model; no scientific, causal, external-truth, or real-world evidence claim.
